# Version 4.150.2
> **Upstream m150 bug-fix servicing** · Released August 5, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.2) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.2)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.2 is a servicing release delivering three rounds of upstream Skia m150 Ganesh bug fixes.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Three rounds of chrome/m150 upstream bug fixes** — Three upstream syncs from the Skia chrome/m150 branch have been applied, pulling in Ganesh stability and correctness improvements from the Skia team. ([#4517](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4517), [#4648](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4648), [#4663](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4663))
- **m150 line updated with additional Ganesh fixes** — A further round of Ganesh-focused fixes was merged into the release/4.150.x line ahead of this build. ([#4561](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4561))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.2

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
